summary: Verified the new 'Your Professional' feature end-to-end. Backend: direct controller test of partner_public_card against a disposable Mongo DB — 9/9 tests pass (payload shape, rating distribution, review masking, authorization matrix, 404 cases, mask_reviewer helper, and list_bookings carrying partner_id). Confirmed no confidential fields (phone/email/address/bank/aadhaar/wallet_balance/earnings/selfie_leak) leak into the response. Frontend: static review of web PartnerProfileModal + CustomerDashboard CurrentStepCard and mobile PartnerProfileSheet + BookingCard — all imports (theme PRIMARY/AMBER/EMERALD/SLATE/TC/useTheme, BottomSheet from ux, api/mediaUrl) resolve, hook order safe, data-testids match the spec. Backend was not runnable (no .env with MONGO_URL) and web_panel/Customer have no node_modules, so no live UI test was executed.

issues: Verified (ShieldCheck) badge next to partner name is shown on web but NOT on mobile chip — only Crown (premium) is rendered. Minor inconsistency with the web chip. The full ShieldCheck is still shown inside the bottom sheet, so this is cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Mirror web behaviour and render the <ShieldCheck/> verified badge beside the partner name in Customer/src/components/customer/BookingCard.tsx CurrentStepCard chip (right after the name Text, before the Crown).
critical_code_review_comments: partner_public_card correctly uses a projection on db.users that excludes phone/email/address/bank — defence-in-depth: good.
db.partner_profiles projection correctly whitelists only {documents.selfie, experience_years, experience, languages} — bank/other docs stay invisible.

jobs_completed uses max(count_documents(completed|paid), stored jobs_completed) — small server-side DB count on every call; for very active partners consider caching or indexing bookings on (partner_id, status). Not a bug.

rating_distribution is derived only from the recent 300 reviews fetched; if a partner has >300 reviews, the distribution shown differs from the stored lifetime stats. Acceptable for 'Recent reviews' but worth noting.

Average rating is recomputed from the fetched reviews rather than the stored users.rating when any reviews exist — fine, but the first few bookings' reviews will dominate the displayed average vs a lifetime stat.

Review date (`at`) is passed through from the stored review dict without validation — if the DB stores it as a datetime instead of ISO string, JSON serialisation of the HTTP response may break. The pytest covers only ISO-string reviews.
booking_controller.py is 4254 lines — well past the 700-line split guideline. Not a regression from this task, but a long-standing refactor opportunity.

CurrentStepCard in CustomerDashboard.jsx is called with a 4th arg `commLocked={commLocked}` at L661 but its signature is `({ b, onCall, onChat })` — the extra prop is silently dropped; `onCall`/`onChat` are received but never used inside the chip. Pre-existing, not caused by this task.
test_credentials: Not needed — direct controller test with seeded disposable DB.
seed_data_creation: Temporary MongoDB database test_partner_card_<uuid> created and dropped by the pytest fixture (seed_and_cleanup teardown). Verified post-run: no residual test_partner_card_* DB remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend partner-card endpoint is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_partner_public_card.py (runs against a disposable DB, independent of the live backend). To re-run: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 python -m pytest tests/test_partner_public_card.py -v`. For UI validation, node_modules are missing in both web_panel and Customer — install (yarn install) is required before running Playwright/Expo flows.
